job.title: Team Lead Education
job.jdText: **This position is based in Germany with hybrid or remote working options. Applicants must hold a valid work/residence permit for the respective location.** Chaos is a leading global software company that provides world-class visualization and design solutions, empowering creative minds to bring ideas to life. For over twenty years, Chaos has developed innovative technologies serving multiple industries, including architecture and design, media and entertainment, and product e-commerce. Chaosâ solutions help architects, designers, VFX artists/animators, and other creative professionals share ideas, optimize workflows, and create immersive experiences. Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, Chaos is a global company with offices in 11 cities worldwide. In 2022, Chaos and Enscape merged, bringing together two industry-leading companies into one. Since then, Chaos has continued to grow with the additions of Cylindo, AXYZ Design, and Evolve Lab, further expanding our expertise and solutions across architecture, design, e-commerce, and AI. For more information, please visit chaos.com . Role Overview The Team Lead, Education Sales leads the Education sales team and owns the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for the Education segment, covering both University and Student markets. The role is responsible for driving new institution and student customer acquisition, growing ARR within the existing base, and reducing churn across both segments. The University segment operates through direct, relationship-led sales to institutions, while the Student segment runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey, requiring close partnership with the Ecommerce team to optimise the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience. Reporting to the Sr. Director GTM Strategy & Transformation, this role requires a commercially driven sales leader with a hands-on approach, a track record of owning segment revenue end-to-end, and the ability to coach and develop a team while remaining personally active in deals. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy and suits someone who wants to build and scale a team rather than maintain one. Main Responsibilities Lead and develop the Education sales team, setting clear individual performance expectations, coaching from the front, and stepping into deals directly where needed to support pipeline and attainment targets. Own and scale a proactive, discovery-led outbound motion to win new institution and student customers, continuously refining outreach cadence and qualification criteria. Drive expansion and retention within the existing student and institution customer base, identifying and executing initiatives that grow ARR and reduce churn. Own ARR and pipeline growth within the University segment through relationship-led, direct sales to institutions, tracking key performance metrics and diagnosing and correcting underperformance. Own ARR and seat growth within the Student segment, which runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey rather than a traditional sales motion; partner with the Ecommerce team to continuously optimize the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience. Own accurate pipeline forecasting and attainment reporting for the Education business, providing reliable visibility into performance for sales reviews and senior leadership. Partner with RevOps, Marketing, Product, and Ecommerce to ensure Education-specific campaigns, content, and product feedback are prioritised and executed effectively. Required Experience At least 5 years of sales experience within a SaaS or technology environment, including demonstrated experience leading a sales team with direct accountability for team performance and revenue outcomes. Proven track record of owning a direct sales territory or segment end-to-end, from pipeline generation through closed, retained revenue. Experience managing and influencing a low-touch, digital or ecommerce-led purchase journey (funnel, conversion, pricing) is a strong advantage. Previous experience in Architecture, Education, EdTech, or a related vertical is an advantage, but not required. Required Skills Takes full ownership of commercial outcomes: builds pipeline, closes deals, and drives team performance without waiting to be directed. Leads by example in the field: comfortable coaching team members through live deals and personally engaging in high-priority opportunities where it makes a difference. Translates ARR and revenue data into clear, defensible strategy, is able to identify where performance is off track, diagnose the root cause, and act on it. Communicates with credibility at senior level: presents team results, forecasts, and strategic needs clearly to VP-level and cross-functional stakeholders. Able to build effective working relationships and collaborate cross-functionally across Ecommerce, RevOps, and Marketing: driving digital funnel and conversion improvements for the Student segment without direct authority. Operates effectively with high autonomy in a fast-moving environment: sets own priorities, creates momentum without close direction, and holds a consistently high personal bar for execution and results. Familiarity with MEDDICC or a similar sales qualification framework is an advantage. We welcome people who value teamwork, stick to their commitments and are curious to explore new ways for achieving mastery. If you believe that you are a good match for the job, just send us your CV in English . Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Confidentiality of all applications is assured. job.title: Influencer Marketing Lead
job.jdText: At Aftershoot, we're building a global community of photographers who spend less time behind their screens and more time behind the lens. Every feature we create, every update we ship, is designed to make post-processing easier, faster, and smarter for photographers around the world. From culling to editing to retouching. Our AI tools do all the heavy lifting, so photographers can focus on what they do best: capturing moments, telling stories, and creating magic. We're a fast-growing, passionate team backed by 100K+ active users globally. Double-digit ARR in less than 4 years, amazing investors and a team who truly believe in our mission. Our mission is clear: Become the default companion for every photographer in the world. If you care deeply about building meaningful products, working with curious and driven teammates, and being part of a team that genuinely loves what they do, we'd love to meet you. Let's create the future of AI in photography, together. About the Role This is a function-owner role, not an execution role. Aftershoot already invests seven figures a year into creators, and creator-led content is one of the biggest drivers of how photographers discover us. What we don't yet have is someone who owns it end to end: who decides where the money goes, which creators earn a renewal, what the content should actually say, and how we prove any of it worked. That's you. You'll set the strategy, own the budget, build the partner roster, and lead a small team of executives who handle day-to-day outreach and campaign management. Most of our creators are based in the US, so you'll be working across US time zones on a regular basis. You'll come in with a clear mandate: make the same spend go three times further, or deliver the same results for meaningfully less. Both are good answers. What You'll Do â¢ Own Aftershoot's global influencer and creator marketing strategy end to end, with the US as the primary market. â¢ Own the annual creator budget: allocate it, defend it, sunset what isn't working, and double down on what is. â¢ Build and maintain the partner roster across YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok, spanning photography, creative-tools, and tech audiences.â¢ Move the program from one-off sponsored posts toward recurring partnerships, ambassador structures, and long-term creator relationships. â¢ Build the measurement layer: attribution, incrementality, cost per trial and per paid conversion by creator, so renewal decisions are made on evidence rather than instinct. â¢ Negotiate rates, deliverables, exclusivity, and usage rights, including whitelisting so strong creator content can be repurposed into paid media. â¢ Get content actually shipped: briefing creators, holding them to timelines, and getting the work over the line when it slips. â¢ Hire, manage, and coach a team of 2â3 Influencer Marketing Executives. â¢ Work closely with Growth, Content, Product Marketing, and Design so creator content plugs into the wider marketing engine rather than running beside it. â¢ Plan and run creator activity around peak moments like Black Friday and major product launches. â¢ Explore adjacent channels where they make sense: affiliate, community, events, and podcast partnerships. What You'll Bring â¢ 5â8 years in influencer, creator, or partnerships marketing, at an agency or in-house, with at least 2 of those years setting strategy rather than only executing campaigns. â¢ Direct experience managing a meaningful creator budget, and the ability to walk us through how you spent it and what you got back. â¢ Experience working with US or international creators, and comfort operating across time zones. â¢ Excellent spoken and written English. Much of this job is video calls and negotiation with US-based creators, so you need to be clear, natural, and persuasive live. â¢ Real negotiation instincts. Paying a creator is the beginning of the relationship, not the end of it, and getting good work out of a partner takes persistence and charm in equal measure. â¢ Comfort with numbers: you can look at a campaign and form a point of view on whether it earned its keep. â¢ Working knowledge of creator tooling and affiliate platforms (GRIN, CreatorIQ, Modash, Upfluence, Aspire, Impact.com , PartnerStack, or similar). â¢ A bias toward action. We move fast, we test in the market rather than in slide decks, and we'd rather fix a live campaign than perfect a plan. Nice to have, genuinely not required â¢ A background in photography, creative tools, or prosumer software. â¢ Experience in a consumer AI or global SaaS company. â¢ Experience building a creator program from zero. We are not filtering for photography experience. If you've built creator programs in D2C, gaming, fintech, or anywhere else that scales, the playbook travels. What You'll Gain â¢ Full ownership of a function from day one, with a seven-figure budget and no legacy playbook to inherit. â¢ Direct line to leadership and real influence over how Aftershoot grows. â¢ A global creator community in a category people are genuinely passionate about. â¢ The chance to build a team around you as the program scales. What Happens After You Apply? Phone Screen â If your profile looks like a fit, our People team will reach out for an intro call. Team Interview â A deeper conversation on your experience and how you've run creator programs before. Case Discussion â We'll share real context on our program a day ahead, then talk through how you'd approach it. No 20-slide deck required. Bar-Raiser Interview â Meet our leadership team for a final evaluation. Offer! â If it goes well, we'll extend a formal offer and welcome you on board. job.jdText: About us HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability. Our People With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home. Our Impact Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. Weâre proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts About the Role We are seeking a Lead Product Designer who can elevate HighLevel's product experiences through exceptional craft, product vision, systems thinking and influence. You have spent 7+ years designing complex digital products, ideally including SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or similarly sophisticated product experiences, and are ready to shape product direction, design standards and team culture across one or more product pillars. As a lead individual contributor, you will partner deeply with product and engineering leaders, mentor other designers and help teams define and improve strategically important product experiences across the HighLevel platform. You will connect customer needs, business goals, technical constraints and long-term product strategy to clear, useful and highly polished product design. We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate an extraordinarily high bar for design craft and visual sophistication, and to raise that bar for the teams around them. You should care deeply about hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, interaction quality, usability, accessibility and the standards that make product experiences feel refined, trustworthy and coherent at scale. We want candidates who can ship truly world-class product design. Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis or workflow acceleration is mandatory. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered. What You Can Expect Autonomy to shape design direction across one or more strategically important product pillars. Meaningful influence with product, engineering and senior leadership on product quality, customer outcomes and roadmap direction. The opportunity to raise the design bar across multiple teams through critique, standards, mentorship and systems thinking. Partnership with ambitious product, engineering, data and design peers who value clarity, speed, craft and customer outcomes. A craft-forward design culture where lead designers help strengthen design practice, improve team rituals and grow other designers. A 100% remote environment where distributed collaboration is normal. Employees in all geographies are expected to be flexible and thoughtful about working hours so US- and India-based colleagues can collaborate effectively. What We Are Looking For 7+ years of relevant product design experience, with 2+ years in a leadership, mentorship or design direction capacity; experience in SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or other complex digital product environments is highly valuable. An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates systematic thinking, customer empathy, exceptional craft, measurable product impact and leadership beyond individual execution. Proven experience leading data-informed product design across the full lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content strategy and usability testing. Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality. Experience designing for AI-driven or intelligent interfaces, including collaboration with machine learning, data, automation or platform teams. Deep fluency in design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions. Experience influencing design direction for high-impact product areas, systems, platforms or pillars, not only individual features or flows. Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, data partners, customer-facing teams, senior stakeholders and other designers. Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas, lead critiques and workshops and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft. Passion for improving team operations, design standards, processes, tools, documentation and better ways for teams to work. In This Role, You Will Lead design strategy and execution for one or more product pillars from discovery through delivery. Translate customer needs, business goals, product strategy and technical constraints into clear experience direction and design roadmaps. Partner with product and engineering leaders to define product vision, prioritize opportunities and align teams around high-quality outcomes. Influence leadership decisions through customer empathy, data synthesis, product judgment, storytelling and strong design rationale. Drive design quality reviews and set standards for usability, accessibility, interaction quality, visual consistency and design system alignment. Raise the quality of multiple teams by mentoring designers, improving critique, strengthening shared patterns and making standards easier to adopt. Define and socialize metrics for design quality and impact, such as usability signals, accessibility compliance, task success, adoption, retention or customer satisfaction. Lead complex discovery and design efforts through ambiguity by synthesizing inputs, framing decisions and helping teams move with clarity. How You Work You raise the bar for craft, visual sophistication and product quality across the teams around you. You move comfortably between product strategy, customer insight, systems thinking and hands-on design execution. You balance speed, detail, scalability and quality without losing sight of the customer. You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability and genuine respect for your teammates as people. You enjoy leading collaboration across time zones and cultural contexts, including with US- and India-based teammates. You communicate in ways that help distributed teams work with clarity, care, trust and momentum. You advocate for accessibility, inclusion and ethical design.   \n \n Equal Employment Opportunity Information The company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. You have anÂ exceptional talent for creating structure , and you take pride in organizing processes and tasks in a way that's efficient and clear. You're genuinelyÂ curious Â about how AI is changing design work and design education, and you look for new ways to use it in your own work. You're kind, and you have theÂ social intelligence and empathy Â to engage well with very different kinds of people. You're fluent in written and spoken English, your grammar is exact, and you understand the power of tone, brevity, and microcopy. You takeÂ full ownership Â of your work and see it through. Youâre enthusiastic about learning by doing and areÂ committed to putting in the effort to continuously improve your skills . Youâre driven by the desire toÂ make a positive impact in the world Â and to improve the lives of others. You're located in aÂ time zone Â between UTC+0 (London) and UTC+4 (Dubai), which covers Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. You've worked with anÂ LMS or an online learning platform . You hold aÂ bachelor's or master's Â degree in communications, journalism, literature, or a similar field. job.jdText: Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send payoutsâgift cards and moneyâto anyone, anywhere, instantly. We're trusted by 20,000+ organizations, from startups to giants like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way, to reach millions of recipients worldwide. We're profitable and growing without outside investors. We're fully remote, with a high-documentation, low-meeting culture that leaves more time for the work that mattersâand for your life outside it. Our employee NPS sits in the high 80s. We move billions of dollars through our systems. That makes security existential, and it's why we're making our first dedicated security hire. About The Role You'll be our first Head of Security. There's already a real foundation hereâbug bounty, pen tests, automated code and configuration scanning on the production and code side, phishing simulations on the people side. Youâll add to it across access and identity, SecOps and monitoring, incident response, vendor security, employee security practices, and policy. You'll own the whole posture. This is a player-coach role. Early on, you'll do the scoping and the hands-on work yourself; this is not a role where you direct from above. As the work demands it, we're fully prepared to build a team hereâand we're looking to you to define what that team should be and when. You'll report to the VP of Engineering , Tremendous' most senior technical leader. We've deliberately placed security with Engineering so you're set up to drive real implementation fastâembedded with the people whose work you're securing, not siloed in a compliance function. As the security function matures, we'll revisit this. What You'll Do Own Tremendous' security posture end-to-end, partnering with our engineering team on production infrastructure and code security. Assess where we have gaps, prioritize them, and tackle our highest-leverage gaps first. Weâll have opinions, but you own the prioritization and implementation. Treat incident response as core, not afterthought. We may not be able to prevent a breach, but your job is making sure it's small, contained, and that we know exactly what to do. Drive security as a cultural shift across the companyâintroducing controls incrementally, working with teams rather than over them. "Yes, and," not "no." Lead our AI-security posture. We invest heavily in AI tooling; your job is to manage that risk and enable it, not to ban it. Define when and how to staff up the security function, and hire your own team. What You'll Bring Real, hands-on security experience at a company that scaledâideally as an early security hire who grew with the business through high growth. Deep experience in at least one core security domainâproduct/production security, security operations, or access/identity and policyâwith enough range to reason across the others. You defined the security posture, not just executed someone elseâs playbook. An engineer's mindset. You reach for code to solve problems and can read our codebase and understand our infrastructure (Ruby on Rails; TypeScript + React; PostgreSQL; Google Cloud). You won't write much day-to-day, but you're not lost in the code. Judgment over checklists. You can explain the actual risk of a given decision, hold a firm line where it matters, and give ground where "best practice" doesn't apply to us or real business need pulls the other way. You can hold your own in a debate about whether to open up broad data access for AI tooling. Bedside manner. You drive hard change by bringing the team around to your point of view, rather than just telling them no. Engineers and the rest of the company want to work with you. Experience building or co-building a small security team is a plus. Fintech, payments, or regulated-industry experience is a plus. What's Cool About The Role You define the function. First security leader, with the budget for the required tools and team. A real mandate. The push for this hire comes straight from the founders. We invest in your tools. Everyone has a $5k/month budget for AI tools. Use it. Competitive pay and equity. Base salary $250,000â$330,000, plus meaningful equity. Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas. Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.
